title: Certificate in Machine Learning and Python Fundamentals
description: Completed a technical training program covering Python programming and machine learning at the entry level. The program included essential topics such as Python syntax, data structures, object-oriented programming, file handling, and error management. It also provided practical experience with libraries like NumPy and Pandas, along with foundational machine learning techniques including linear regression, polynomial regression, decision trees, support vector regression, and random forest. Training involved applying these concepts to real-world datasets using Jupyter Notebook and Anaconda.

Practical experience with data analysis and scientific computing using NumPy and Pandas
